30. Blocking vs Non-blocking I/O

Blocking calls wait before returning; non-blocking calls return without waiting for completion, with
readiness or completion mechanisms used to continue work.

Q: Is non-blocking I/O the same as CPU parallelism?
A: No; overlap in I/O does not imply simultaneous CPU execution.
